_about: The three holders on the bed, as all-shapes-test.js draws them on the machine (hardware-verified). x, y = the holder centre in MACHINE coordinates (MPos, mm) from physical home ($H). width, height = the keychain outline (mm): the border that is engraved; the name and photo go inside it. The printer agent and Laser Queue both read this file; change a value here and restart the agent.
